description: Evacuate one island fully, then reuse its high dock as a transfer point: the bridge closes the south breach and the whole south market walks home; the south skiff drops the north market at the emptied south high dock (a staging point, not a refuge), and each drop is walked on over the bridge to the receiving dock (one order after the first four, one after the last); the west and east skiffs land at the high landing, so no boat ever needs the pontoon channel.
